other_exits: Target Profit close: if InpTargetProfit>0 and cumulative position profit >= InpTakeProfit (likely a bug, compares money profit to pips TP), closes all positions and deletes all pending orders
InpPendingClosePrevious: when a new signal fires, optionally deletes all existing pending orders before placing new ones
Pending order expiration: orders expire after InpPendingExpiration minutes (default 600) if >0

position_sizing.conditional_logic: InpLotOrRisk selects mode: lots_min=minimum allowed lot, lot=fixed lots at InpVolumeLotOrRisk, risk=CMoneyFixedMargin (risk percent for deal using InpVolumeLotOrRisk as percentage). Risk mode calculates lot via CheckOpenLong/CheckOpenShort with SL distance.

custom_logic_notes: Pending order type controlled by InpTradeMode: stop=BUY_STOP/SELL_STOP, limit=BUY_LIMIT/SELL_LIMIT. One deal per bar per direction enforced via m_last_deal_buy_in/m_last_deal_sell_in timestamps. InpPendingOnlyOne flag prevents new pending if one already exists. InpTrailingBarCurrent controls whether trailing runs at every tick (bar_0) or only on new bar (bar_1). Freeze/Stops level coefficients applied via InpFreezeCoefficient. LotsLimit check sums volumes of all positions and pending orders before placing new order. Account LimitOrders check before placing pending. Bug: Target profit check compares ProfitAllPositions() (money) against InpTakeProfit (pips value).
python_conversion_notes: Key challenges: (1) Pending order lifecycle management with expiration, freeze/stops level validation, and conditional deletion of previous orders. (2) CMoneyFixedMargin lot sizing requires replication of margin-check logic. (3) The InpTradeMode toggle between stop and limit pending types changes order direction relative to price. (4) One-deal-per-bar guard uses OnTradeTransaction to track deal entry times. (5) Trailing stop has activate threshold + step logic. (6) Spread filter on pending order placement only. (7) Time control supports both intraday and cross-midnight intervals. (8) Note the probable bug where TargetProfit (money) is compared against InpTakeProfit (pips) - may need decision on whether to preserve or fix.
